summary: Explains that default is required with _task in conditionals since they're evaluated each iteration, while register projections run after the task completes and don't need it.
questions: Why do I need the default filter with _task in a when condition?
Do I need default when using _task.loop_result in register?

answer_card.title: Why default is needed with _task
answer_card.answer_md: Conditionals are evaluated **during each iteration**, so the first iteration has no previous result and needs `| default(...)`. Register projections are evaluated **after** the task completes, so `default` isn't needed there.
